'''Fire lilies''' were flowers. The [[holostar]] [[Javul Charn]] and her entourage were showered with [[black]] fire lilies as they boarded her [[Starship/Legends|ship]], the ''[[Nova's Heart]]'', after a personal appearance on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Realizing that they were from [[Hityamun Kris|the same person]] who had sent her a series of threatening [[Holomail|messages]], Charn subsequently tightened her security.
